review_method: macOS Preview Live Text followed by manual original-resolution visual comparison of the title, root box, connector, and numbered couple box 4; temporary crops were disposable instrumentation and the hashed source image remains the evidence owner
source_context: photographed Japanese family-tree sheet in the owner-identified Menmen/Yasuko family album
layout_observation: A vertical connector descends from the top 今村清之助 root box to the horizontal descendant row containing numbered couple box 4, where 松井慶四郎 is paired with 照子.
claim_supported: The family-held sheet represents Teruko / 照子 as belonging to Seinosuke Imamura's descendant line and pairs her with Keishiro Matsui. Together with the sheet title, this is direct family-tree evidence for the working identity Teruko Imamura / 今村照子 and a likely father-daughter edge from Seinosuke Imamura to Teruko.
claim_not_yet_supported: The sheet has not received a second Japanese-speaking human review. Biological versus legal/adoptive parentage is not distinguished, and the root spouse candidate （斉藤）家寿 is not promoted because that reading is less secure.

related_provider_occurrence.relationship: near-identical second Drive image of the same photographed sheet; independently hashed in the Drive manifest, not an independent evidence lineage
